name: R2a corpus
note: Hand-written targets for the R2a needs (memory-v4 plan §2.2), shaped like real outcomes of a fictional local job runner, lantern. Ten are near-miss distractors that no need counts. eval.ts adds every Layer A fixture's items to this repo.

event.summary: Added jittered exponential backoff to the panel websocket client.

archived.title: Panel socket reconnect
archived.prompt: Make the web panel reconnect its websocket after the daemon restarts.

op.text: Reset the websocket backoff after a successful open, or panel reconnects stay slow.
op.label: sock-pitfall

event.summary: Migrations now run one per BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and recheck user_version inside each.

archived.title: Schema migration runner
archived.prompt: Build an ordered migration runner for the sqlite store.

op.text: Two daemons opening an old sqlite file at once can both migrate it unless the version is rechecked inside the write lock.
op.label: mig-pitfall

op.text: To add a schema migration, append it to MIGRATIONS and bump SCHEMA_VERSION; never edit a shipped one.
op.label: mig-proc

event.summary: Commands exit 2 on usage errors, 3 when the daemon is unreachable and 1 otherwise.

archived.title: CLI exit codes
archived.prompt: Give every lantern CLI command a documented exit code.

op.text: Scripts depend on lantern CLI exit status 3 meaning the daemon is down; keep it stable.
op.label: exit-note

event.summary: Environment variables override the project file, which overrides the user file.

archived.title: Config layering
archived.prompt: Merge user, project and environment configuration in one place.

op.text: A project config.json can only tighten security keys; it must never loosen what the user file set.
op.label: cfg-pitfall

op.text: Run lantern config --explain to see which layer set each key.
op.label: cfg-proc

event.summary: The release job signs with the Developer ID certificate and staples the notarization ticket.

archived.title: Notarize macOS builds
archived.prompt: Sign and notarize the macOS app in the release workflow.

op.text: notarytool rejects the upload when the hardened runtime entitlement is missing.
op.label: sign-pitfall

event.summary: The test raced a real timer; it now uses fake timers and advances the clock explicitly.

archived.title: Stabilize scheduler test
archived.prompt: The scheduler test fails intermittently on CI; find out why.

op.text: Intermittent CI failures in scheduler tests come from real timers; use fake timers.
op.label: flaky-pitfall

op.text: Rerun a suspected intermittent test with vitest --repeat 50 before calling it fixed.
op.label: flaky-proc

event.summary: Cmd+1..9 switch jobs and Cmd+K opens the command palette.

archived.title: UI keyboard shortcuts
archived.prompt: Add keyboard shortcuts to the UI for switching jobs.

op.text: Keyboard shortcuts in the UI must not steal keys from the embedded terminal.
op.label: keys-note

event.summary: After five attempts a job moves to the dead-letter queue and shows in lantern jobs --dead.

archived.title: Dead-letter queue
archived.prompt: Jobs that keep failing should stop retrying forever.

op.text: Retrying a job without an attempt cap filled the queue when a plugin crashed on every run.
op.label: dlq-pitfall

openQuestions: Should dead-letter jobs expire after a week?

event.summary: daemon.log rotates at 10 MB and keeps five gzip archives.

archived.title: Rotate daemon logs
archived.prompt: The daemon log grows without bound.

op.text: Rotating the log by rename breaks tail -F on some systems; copy then truncate instead.
op.label: log-pitfall

event.summary: Tokens carry an idle deadline; the panel asks for a new pairing code when one lapses.

archived.title: Session token expiry
archived.prompt: Expire panel session tokens after 12 hours idle.

op.text: Comparing token expiry with the client clock logged users out early; compare on the daemon.
op.label: tok-pitfall

op.text: Revoke all session tokens with lantern auth revoke --all after a suspected leak.
op.label: tok-proc

event.summary: lantern gc removes worktrees whose job is gone and runs git worktree prune.

archived.title: Prune stale worktrees
archived.prompt: Remove git worktrees left behind by crashed jobs.

op.text: Never delete a worktree directory with rm -rf while git still has it registered; use git worktree remove.
op.label: wt-pitfall

event.summary: The PTY now receives SIGWINCH with the new rows and columns on every resize.

archived.title: Terminal resize
archived.prompt: Terminal output wraps wrongly after resizing the window.

op.text: Resize the PTY before replaying scrollback, or the replay wraps at the old width.
op.label: pty-pitfall

event.summary: Native notifications fire for input-needed jobs; finished jobs stay silent by default.

archived.title: Desktop notifications
archived.prompt: Notify the human when a job needs input.

op.text: The human wants desktop notifications only when input is needed, never for every finished job.
op.label: notif-note

event.summary: A token bucket allows 20 requests per second per client and answers 429 beyond it.

archived.title: API rate limit
archived.prompt: Protect the HTTP API from runaway clients.

op.text: The rate limiter keyed on remote address throttled every local client together; key on the session instead.
op.label: rl-pitfall

event.summary: Cache keys now hash the lockfile and the Node version.

archived.title: Build cache keys
archived.prompt: Stale build artifacts survive dependency upgrades.

op.text: Caching node_modules across Node major versions produced native module crashes; key the cache on the Node version.
op.label: cache-pitfall

event.summary: lantern backup writes a consistent copy with VACUUM INTO.

archived.title: Store backup command
archived.prompt: Let the human back up the sqlite store safely while the daemon runs.

op.text: Copying the sqlite file with cp while the daemon writes misses the WAL; use VACUUM INTO.
op.label: bak-pitfall

event.summary: Plugins run in a worker with a permission manifest checked before every file or network call.

archived.title: Plugin isolation
archived.prompt: Plugins can read any file; isolate them.

op.text: A plugin manifest that lists network access must name hosts; a bare wildcard is rejected.
op.label: plug-pitfall

op.text: Test a plugin with lantern plugin run --dry to print the permissions it would use.
op.label: plug-proc

event.summary: Strings moved to locales/*.json and the panel picks the browser language.

archived.title: Translate the panel
archived.prompt: Ship German and Japanese strings for the panel.

op.text: Plural rules differ per locale; use Intl.PluralRules instead of appending an s.
op.label: i18n-pitfall

event.summary: GET /metrics serves Prometheus text with job, queue and HTTP histograms.

archived.title: Prometheus metrics
archived.prompt: Expose job counts and queue latency for scraping.

op.text: The metrics endpoint is local-only; never expose it on a public interface.
op.label: met-note

event.summary: Watcher events are debounced for 150 ms and coalesced per path.

archived.title: Debounce file watcher
archived.prompt: Saving one file triggers five rebuilds.

op.text: fs.watch on macOS reports a rename for atomic saves; treat rename as change.
op.label: watch-pitfall

event.summary: lantern index --rebuild reindexes everything and the daemon checks index health at startup.

archived.title: Rebuild search index
archived.prompt: Search misses jobs created while the indexer was down.

op.text: Running FTS optimize during a rebuild doubled the index size until the next vacuum.
op.label: idx-pitfall

event.summary: Docs build with a small markdown renderer into site/ and deploy from the release job.

archived.title: Docs site build
archived.prompt: Publish the docs folder as a static site.

op.text: Relative links in docs break on the site unless the renderer rewrites .md to .html.
op.label: docs-pitfall

event.summary: Log lines pass through a redactor for bearer tokens, AWS keys and private key blocks.

archived.title: Redact secrets in logs
archived.prompt: API keys showed up in job logs.

op.text: Redacting after truncation let half a token through; redact the whole line first, then cut.
op.label: red-pitfall

op.text: Add a sample to redact.test.ts for every new secret pattern.
op.label: red-proc

event.summary: Schedules are stored with an IANA zone and expanded with Temporal.

archived.title: Cron schedules in local time
archived.prompt: Scheduled jobs fire an hour off after daylight saving changes.

op.text: A 02:30 schedule does not exist on spring-forward days; run it at 03:00 instead.
op.label: tz-pitfall

openQuestions: Should schedules default to the daemon's zone or UTC?

event.summary: Closed jobs kept their scrollback buffers; they are now released on close.

archived.title: Fix daemon memory leak
archived.prompt: Daemon RSS climbs by 50 MB a day.

op.text: Event listeners added per job without removal kept closed jobs alive; remove them on close.
op.label: leak-pitfall

event.summary: Startup reports which process holds the port and exits with code 4.

archived.title: Port in use at startup
archived.prompt: The daemon crashes when port 7700 is taken.

op.text: EADDRINUSE on restart came from the old daemon still draining; wait for its pid to exit.
op.label: port-pitfall

event.summary: The updater keeps the previous build and restores it when the new one fails its health check.

archived.title: Updater rollback
archived.prompt: A failed self-update left the app unable to start.

op.text: A stale update lock from a dead helper silently blocked every later update check.
op.label: upd-pitfall

op.text: Test the updater by running lantern update --channel canary on a scratch home.
op.label: upd-proc

event.summary: Shell commands outside the allowlist now need the human's approval in the panel.

archived.title: Command approval policy
archived.prompt: Agents run shell commands without asking.

op.text: Matching the allowlist by prefix approved npm test --exec rm; match whole argv instead.
op.label: appr-pitfall

op.text: Grant a one-off command with lantern approve <id>; persistent grants go in approvals.json.
op.label: appr-proc

event.summary: Uploads stream to a temp file with a 5 GB cap instead of buffering.

archived.title: Stream large uploads
archived.prompt: Uploading a 2 GB artifact runs the daemon out of memory.

op.text: Busboy file streams must be drained on error or the request hangs.
op.label: up-pitfall

event.summary: Every icon button has an aria-label and the job list is a labelled listbox.

archived.title: Screen reader labels
archived.prompt: VoiceOver reads the job list as unlabeled buttons.

op.text: aria-live on the whole log pane made screen readers announce every line; limit it to status.
op.label: a11y-pitfall

op.text: Check new panels with the axe audit in npm run a11y before review.
op.label: a11y-proc

event.summary: The panel uses a two-column grid above 900 px.

archived.title: Panel layout grid
archived.prompt: Tidy the panel layout on narrow screens.

op.text: Database migration of the marketing site to the new host is the web team's job, not ours.
The CLI retry flag only applies to network commands.

event.summary: Footer shows prompt and completion tokens per job.

archived.title: Token counter in footer
archived.prompt: Show model token usage in the footer.

op.text: Run lantern doctor to print versions of node, git and the daemon.
Keyboard layout settings live in the OS, not in lantern.
Log timestamps are UTC; convert in the panel, not in the daemon.

event.summary: The sidebar shows a badge with the queued job count.

archived.title: Queue depth badge
archived.prompt: Show how many jobs wait in the queue.

op.text: Release notes are drafted from merged pull request titles.
Backups of user home directories are out of scope for lantern.
